independent_dynamic_checks.aggregate_implementation_test_counts: Reported by the parent separately; these 32 reviewer checks are not added to implementation-suite totals.

static_review: P1 uses its own domain port; it neither imports recommendation classes nor loops getProfile. The source is internal data access, not proof of viewer authorization.

P1 SQL reads only requested owner/scope/field rows with confirmed/authenticated markers. Native expressions are built from FieldCatalog and checked against the stored field and binding; no arbitrary stored column is executed.

P1 state comparison covers state identity, separate revisions/permission versions, identity_version and current_revision_id. Missing state is zero-version/empty data, not implicit state creation or confirmed identity.
P8 validates actual active viewer/candidates, enabled current Space, formal membership and user/Space blocks in batches. No administrator bypass or per-owner database loop was introduced.
P8 purpose policy allows 18 reviewed ordinary discovery sources; contacts, raw sources, drafts, friends/private attributes and excess metadata are excluded.
P8 now uses eligibility1 -> source1 -> eligibility2 -> source2 comparison -> eligibility3, with no profile read after the last native gate.

Recommendation bridge validates current server-selected activity before and after the call, restricts requested IDs, verifies scope/version shape, and obtains values only through the injected authorized P8 boundary.
Recommendation published binding semantics remain pinned independently from live directory changes. A removed or changed optional source becomes unknown without reintroducing raw native fields.
All reviewed native SQL adapters reject old ambient transactions, use the master with cache disabled, suppress SQL logging/profiling and sanitize dependency exceptions.
No new HTTP route, persistent index writer, migration or production/test provider default was introduced by these new batch classes.
limitations: SQLite fixtures validate the isolated logic and SQL shape, not production MySQL behavior, lock/isolation performance, installed runtime composition or public API.
Current selection and viewer identity must come from the trusted composition root. Direct P1/P8 internal calls do not establish a server-selected activity merely by receiving integer IDs.
Checks establish bounded observations during a call, not a permanent grant, a global monotonic permission epoch, a cross-table atomic snapshot or complete ABA detection.
Out-of-band native edits that bypass P1 version updates are not covered by P1 version comparison; existing protected write paths remain necessary.
Identity version 0 denotes missing saved identity state and must not be interpreted as confirmed identity.
Persistent index synchronization and authorization generations, real idea projection, complete request history, HTTP assembly and AI remain outside this gap repair.
No whole-tree core/vendor or frozen-document hash audit was repeated by this reviewer; the parent handles final boundary evidence.
The report records reviewed file hashes at this instant. Later source changes need a targeted review before reusing the conclusions.
